text: nahi hai bhai abhi mai baad mei de dunga
gloss: no money now, will give later. Commitment verb but no date at all.
note: A commitment with no date is not actionable. Nothing to suppress contact until.

text: baar baar text karna band kardo bhai nahi chahiye abhi cancel kardo
gloss: stop texting me, don't want it, cancel it
note: Stop-contact and cancel-subscription in one message. Our schema has one flag for both.

text: maine to kar diya tha payment gaya kyu nahi
gloss: I did pay, why didn't it go through
note: A claim, not a settlement. INV-1: only reconciliation may say recovered.

text: fifteenth se pehle nahi de paunga mai abhi paise nahi hai
gloss: I cannot pay BEFORE the fifteenth, no money now
note: A date bounded from below is not a commitment on that date. The negation inverts it.

text: hai nahi kate paise? issue to nahi hona chahiye koi. phirse try karta hu
gloss: the money wasn't taken? shouldn't be a problem. I'll try again
note: Offers to try. No date, no commitment to pay.

text: abhi haath tight hai thoda mai karta hu do chaar din mei
gloss: money is tight, I'll do it in two-to-four days
note: A range, not a point. A human reads this as a commitment inside four days.

text: aath tareek kebaad msg karna tab kar dunga
gloss: message me after the 8th, I'll do it then
note: A contact instruction, not a promise. Treating it as a promise suppresses contact AND then records a broken promise.

text: cancel karde bhai nahi hai abhi paise jab ayenge tab renew kara lunga
gloss: cancel it, no money now, I'll renew when I have some
note: Subscription cancellation, not a TRAI DND opt-out. Same flag serves both.
Looking is not paying. A date attached to a hedge is still a hedge.

text: ho gaya na payment? check karo
gloss: the payment went through, right? check

text: paise kat gaye lekin subscription active nahi hai
gloss: money was deducted but the subscription isn't active
note: Claims payment and reports a service fault. The payment half is what matters here.

text: mera account hi nahi hai aapke yahan
gloss: I don't even have an account with you

note: Terse, but in reply to a payment chase a human reads it as a commitment.

text: bhej diya hai screenshot bhejun kya
gloss: I've sent it, shall I send a screenshot
note: Offers proof, which is a strong claim.
Devanagari. A refusal with no commitment and no date.

gloss: I'll do it on the fifteenth
